items.generated_en: The words of the Most High.

items.generated_zh: 听见了，来把心里后来魔鬼话夺走过，使他们不信过、不救。
items.generated_en: I heard it, come and take away the devil's words in my heart, so that they do not believe and do not save.

items.generated_zh: 暂时信过，但试炼时就跌倒了的人。
items.generated_en: Temporarily trusted, but fell during the trial.

items.generated_zh: 听了，却被生活的忧虑、财富和享乐挤住，不能成熟。
items.generated_en: I listened, but was squeezed by the worries of life, wealth, and pleasure, unable to mature.
items.expected: Hear word, choked by life's cares.

items.generated_zh: 听 至高者 话并遵行的人。
items.generated_en: Those who listen to the Most High and follow His words.
